segments.sn22.89:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū kosambiyaṃ viharanti ghositārāme.
segments.sn22.89:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā khemako badarikārāme viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
segments.sn22.89:1.3: Atha kho therā bhikkhū sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhitā āyasmantaṃ dāsakaṃ āmantesuṃ –
segments.sn22.89:1.4: “ehi tvaṃ, āvuso dāsaka, yena khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi –
segments.sn22.89:1.6: kacci te, āvuso, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo’”ti?
segments.sn22.89:1.7: “Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā dāsako therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā khemako tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.89:1.9: ‘kacci te, āvuso, khamanīyaṃ … pe … no abhikkamo’”ti?
segments.sn22.89:1.10: “Na me, āvuso, khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ … pe … abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo”ti.
segments.sn22.89:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā dāsako yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etadavoca –
segments.sn22.89:2.3: ‘na me, āvuso, khamanīyaṃ … pe … abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo’”ti.
segments.sn22.89:2.4: “Ehi tvaṃ, āvuso dāsaka, yena khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi –
segments.sn22.89:2.6: pañcime, āvuso, upādānakkhandhā vuttā bhagavatā, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.sn22.89:2.8: Imesu āyasmā khemako pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassatī’”ti?
segments.sn22.89:3.1: “Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā dāsako therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā khemako tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā … pe …
segments.sn22.89:3.5: Imesu āyasmā khemako pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassatī”ti?
segments.sn22.89:3.8: Imesu khvāhaṃ, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmī”ti.
segments.sn22.89:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā dāsako yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etadavoca –
segments.sn22.89:4.5: Imesu khvāhaṃ, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmī’”ti.
segments.sn22.89:4.6: “Ehi tvaṃ, āvuso dāsaka, yena khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi –
segments.sn22.89:4.8: pañcime, āvuso, upādānakkhandhā vuttā bhagavatā, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.sn22.89:4.10: No ce kirāyasmā khemako imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassati.
segments.sn22.89:5.1: “Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā dāsako therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā khemako … pe …
segments.sn22.89:5.5: no ce kirāyasmā khemako imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassati, tenahāyasmā khemako arahaṃ khīṇāsavo”ti.
segments.sn22.89:5.8: Imesu khvāhaṃ, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmi, na camhi arahaṃ khīṇāsavo;
segments.sn22.89:5.9: api ca me, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu ‘asmī’ti adhigataṃ,‘ayamahamasmī’ti na ca samanupassāmī”ti.
segments.sn22.89:6.1: Atha kho āyasmā dāsako yena therā bhikkhū … pe …
segments.sn22.89:6.4: pañcime, āvuso, upādānakkhandhā vuttā bhagavatā, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.sn22.89:6.6: Imesu khvāhaṃ, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmi, na camhi arahaṃ khīṇāsavo;
segments.sn22.89:6.7: api ca me, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu ‘asmī’ti adhigataṃ,‘ayamahamasmī’ti na ca samanupassāmī”ti.
segments.sn22.89:7.1: “Ehi tvaṃ, āvuso dāsaka, yena khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi –
segments.sn22.89:7.3: yametaṃ, āvuso khemaka, asmīti vadesi, kimetaṃ asmīti vadesi?
segments.sn22.89:7.4: Rūpaṃ asmīti vadesi, aññatra rūpā asmīti vadesi,
segments.sn22.89:7.8: viññāṇaṃ asmīti vadesi, aññatra viññāṇā asmīti vadesi.
segments.sn22.89:7.9: Yametaṃ, āvuso khemaka, asmīti vadesi. Kimetaṃ asmīti vadesī’”ti?
segments.sn22.89:8.1: “Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā dāsako therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā khemako tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.89:8.9: Yametaṃ, āvuso khemaka,‘asmī’ti vadesi, kimetaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadesi”ti?
segments.sn22.89:9.1: Atha kho āyasmā khemako daṇḍamolubbha yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā therehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.sn22.89:9.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ therā bhikkhū etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn22.89:9.9: Yametaṃ, āvuso khemaka,‘asmī’ti vadesi, kimetaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadesī”ti?
segments.sn22.89:9.10: “Na khvāhaṃ, āvuso, rūpaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadāmi; napi aññatra rūpā ‘asmī’ti vadāmi.
segments.sn22.89:9.14: na viññāṇaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadāmi; napi aññatra viññāṇā ‘asmī’ti vadāmi.
segments.sn22.89:9.15: Api ca me, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu ‘asmī’ti adhigataṃ ‘ayamahamasmī’ti na ca samanupassāmi”.
segments.sn22.89:10.1: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, uppalassa vā padumassa vā puṇḍarīkassa vā gandho.
segments.sn22.89:10.2: Yo nu kho evaṃ vadeyya – ‘pattassa gandho’ti vā ‘vaṇṇassa [vaṇḍassa (katthaci)] gandho’ti vā ‘kiñjakkhassa gandho’ti vā sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyā”ti?
segments.sn22.89:10.5: “‘Pupphassa gandho’ti kho, āvuso, sammā byākaramāno byākareyyā”ti.
segments.sn22.89:10.6: “Evameva khvāhaṃ, āvuso, na rūpaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadāmi, napi aññatra rūpā ‘asmī’ti vadāmi.
segments.sn22.89:10.10: na viññāṇaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadāmi, napi aññatra viññāṇā ‘asmī’ti vadāmi.
segments.sn22.89:10.11: Api ca me, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu ‘asmī’ti adhigataṃ ‘ayamahamasmī’ti na ca samanupassāmi”.
segments.sn22.89:11.1: “Kiñcāpi, āvuso, ariyasāvakassa pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pahīnāni bhavanti, atha khvassa hoti – ‘yo ca pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato asmīti māno, asmīti chando, asmīti anusayo asamūhato.
segments.sn22.89:11.2: So aparena samayena pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati –
segments.sn22.89:11.3: iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo;
segments.sn22.89:11.7: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo’ti.
segments.sn22.89:11.8: Tassimesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato yopissa hoti pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato ‘asmī’ti, māno ‘asmī’ti, chando ‘asmī’ti anusayo asamūhato, sopi samugghātaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn22.89:12.1: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, vatthaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ malaggahitaṃ. Tamenaṃ sāmikā rajakassa anupadajjuṃ.
segments.sn22.89:12.2: Tamenaṃ rajako ūse vā khāre vā gomaye vā sammadditvā acche udake vikkhāleti.
segments.sn22.89:12.3: Kiñcāpi taṃ hoti vatthaṃ parisuddhaṃ pariyodātaṃ, atha khvassa hoti yeva anusahagato ūsagandho vā khāragandho vā gomayagandho vā asamūhato.
segments.sn22.89:12.4: Tamenaṃ rajako sāmikānaṃ deti. Tamenaṃ sāmikā gandhaparibhāvite karaṇḍake nikkhipanti.
segments.sn22.89:12.5: Yopissa hoti anusahagato ūsagandho vā khāragandho vā gomayagandho vā asamūhato, sopi samugghātaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn22.89:12.6: Evameva kho, āvuso, kiñcāpi ariyasāvakassa pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pahīnāni bhavanti, atha khvassa hoti yeva pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato ‘asmī’ti, māno ‘asmī’ti, chando ‘asmī’ti anusayo asamūhato.
segments.sn22.89:12.7: So aparena samayena pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati.
segments.sn22.89:12.8: ‘Iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo;
segments.sn22.89:12.12: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo’ti.
segments.sn22.89:12.13: Tassa imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato yopissa hoti pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato ‘asmī’ti, māno ‘asmī’ti, chando ‘asmī’ti anusayo asamūhato, sopi samugghātaṃ gacchatī”ti.
segments.sn22.89:13.1: Evaṃ vutte, therā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn22.89:13.2: “na kho [na kho pana (ka.)] mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ vihesāpekhā pucchimha, api cāyasmā khemako pahosi tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ.
segments.sn22.89:13.3: Tayidaṃ āyasmatā khemakena tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhitaṃ desitaṃ paññāpitaṃ paṭṭhapitaṃ vivaritaṃ vibhajitaṃ uttānīkatan”ti.
segments.sn22.89:14.2: Attamanā therā bhikkhū āyasmato khemakassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanduṃ.
segments.sn22.89:14.3: Imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu, āyasmato khemakassa cāti.

lines: Asmīti adhigatanti asmīti evaṃ pavattā taṇhāmānā adhigatā.
Dāsakatthero pana catukkhattuṃ gamanāgamanena taṃdivasaṃ dviyojanaṃ addhānaṃ āhiṇḍi.
Therassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ araññaṃ sambādhaṃ, tattha saṭṭhimattānaṃ therānaṃ ṭhātuṃ vā nisīdituṃ vā okāso natthīti na gatā.
“Idhāgantvā amhākaṃ dhammaṃ kathetū” tipi kasmā pana na pahiṇiṃsūti?
Na khvāhaṃ, āvuso, rūpanti yo hi rūpameva asmīti vadati, tena itare cattāro khandhā paccakkhātā honti.
Yo aññatra rūpā vadati, tena rūpaṃ paccakkhātaṃ hoti.
Therassa pana samūhato pañcasupi khandhesu asmīti adhigato, tasmā evamāha.

Evameva khoti ettha idaṃ opammasaṃsandanaṃ – kiliṭṭhavatthaṃ viya hi puthujjanassa cittācāro, tayo khārā viya tisso anupassanā, tīhi khārehi dhotavatthaṃ viya desanāya madditvā ṭhito anāgāmino cittācāro, anusahagato ūsādigandho viya arahattamaggavajjhā kilesā, gandhakaraṇḍako viya arahattamaggañāṇaṃ gandhakaraṇḍakaṃ āgamma anusahagatānaṃ ūsagandhādīnaṃ samugghāto viya arahattamaggena sabbakilesakkhayo, gandhaparibhāvitavatthaṃ nivāsetvā chaṇadivase antaravīthiyaṃ sugandhagandhino vicaraṇaṃ viya khīṇāsavassa sīlagandhādīhi dasa disā upavāyantassa yathākāmacāro.
Saṭṭhimattānaṃ therānanti te kira therena kathitakathitaṭṭhāne vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā uparūpari sammasantā desanāpariyosāne arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.
Theropi aññena nīhārena akathetvā vipassanāsahagatacitteneva kathesi.
“saṭṭhimattānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu āyasmato khemakassa cā”ti.
Taṇhāmāno adhigato arahattassa anadhigatattā, no diṭṭhimāno adhigato, tathā kāmarāgabyāpādāpi.
Catukkhattuṃ gamanāgamanenāti catukkhattuṃ gamanena ca āgamanena ca.
Rūpameva asmīti vadatīti rūpakkhandhameva “asmī”ti gāhassa vatthuṃ katvā vadati.

after.title: Khemakasuttavaṇṇanā
lines: Tayo khārā viya tisso anupassanā cittasaṃkilesassa visodhanato.

after.title: Khemakasuttavaṇṇanā
lines: Suvibhattaṃ kātunti anvayato byatirekato suṭṭhu, vibhattaṃ kātuṃ.
